/*selectBuyerMpSoDlvryDlyPunchOutProgressList*/ SELECT PR.REF_PR_NO REF_PR_NO, PR.PR_NO PR_NO, PR.BUYER_ITEM_NO BUYER_ITEM_NO, PR.DESCRIPTION DESCRIPTION, PR.SPECIFICATION SPECIFICATION, PR.UNIT_MEASURE UNIT_MEASURE, PO.ITEM_QTY ITEM_QTY, TRUNC(SYSDATE - TO_DATE(PO.RD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),0) DELAY_DAY, PR.CHANGE_DATE CHANGE_DATE, PH.PO_CREATE_DATE PO_CREATE_DATE, PO.RD_DATE RD_DATE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = PH.AGENT) AGENT_TEXT, PH.PURCHASER_NAME PURCHASER_NAME, PR.BUYER BUYER, PR.PR_SEQ PR_SEQ, PH.AGENT AGENT, PH.PURCHASER_ID PURCHASER_ID, PR.BYIT_COMORG_CODE BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PO.UNIT_PRICE UNIT_PRICE, TRUNC(NVL(PO.ITEM_QTY * PO.UNIT_PRICE,0)) PO_SUM, PO.LEGACY_PO_NO LEGACY_PO_NO, PO.LEGACY_PO_SEQ LEGACY_PO_SEQ, TRIM(PR.BUYER_ITEM_NO) KEP_BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM ICOMPODT PO, ICOMPOHD PH, ICOMPRDT PR WHERE PO.BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND PO.RD_DATE < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND NVL(PO.GR_QTY,0) < PO.ITEM_QTY AND NVL(PO.DI_QTY,0) < PO.ITEM_QTY AND PR.SAVE_FLAG = 'PX' AND PR.CHANGE_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND PO.BUYER = PH.BUYER AND PO.PO_NO = PH.PO_NO AND PO.BUYER = PR.BUYER AND PO.PR_NO = PR.PR_NO AND PO.PR_SEQ = PR.PR_SEQ AND PO.BUYER_ITEM_NO = PR.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND PR.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND PO.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND PH.STATUS IN ('C','R')
AND UPPER(PR.LEGACY_PO_NO) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_legacy_po_no}||'%')
AND UPPER(PR.BUYER_ITEM_NO) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_buyer_item_no}||'%')
ORDER BY PO.LEGACY_PO_NO
